title: Meta's AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
quote: Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use, to which our customers have agreed.

title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse agent from shopping on users' behalf
quote: Muse fails to identify itself as an agent in HTTP requests, violating Amazon's terms of service... an undisclosed third party moving through customer accounts. Amazon sued Perplexity AI over its Comet browser's shopping capabilities last year; though an appeals court dismissed the case in August, it preserved Amazon's right to block agents breaching its terms of service.

title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse AI assistant in new standoff over agentic shopping
quote: Third-party shopping agents should operate openly and respect service provider decisions about whether or not to participate.

title: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
quote: A simple ClickFix attack is only one way to completely hijack the new agent.

title: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent
quote: An undocumented Muse setting that enabled potential attackers running local code to redirect transcription processing from Meta's servers.

title: Patrick Wardle discloses Muse 0-day that lets local apps hijack Meta's AI assistant
quote: Redirect the assistant's cloud transcription endpoint to an attacker's server and capture the token authenticating the user's Muse account.

title: fix(python): close literal-route bypass via percent-encoded path separator
quote: curl /api/premium -> 402, curl --path-as-is /api%2Fpremium -> 200 with the full paid body.

title: fix(ts): match HTTP routes on escaped and decoded paths
quote: TypeScript HTTP resource servers matched protected routes against path only... a literal route such as GET /api/premium cannot be reached unpaid when the framework dispatches /api%2Fpremium as /api/premium.

title: fix(go): match HTTP routes on escaped and decoded paths
quote: Port of the Python and TypeScript route-matching fix to the Go SDK.

title: Identity Digital Spins Out Known to Advance AI Agent Accountability
quote: Agent accountability needs to work across companies, platforms, and ecosystems. Known has submitted an Internet-Draft to the IETF, and is participating in the Linux Foundation ecosystem through both the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) and LF Decentralized Trust (LFDT).

title: Identity Digital spins out agentic effort, now called Known
quote: Identity Digital will retain an investor stake and board position, while Ethos Capital provides backing.
